card.name: Small linking words mid-sentence
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as "that", "or", "and", "been" and "time" that sit where a noun phrase or clause continues. They appear in both drug-label and general web text.

modes.label: or/and joining items
modes.description: The word "or" or "and" links two parallel items, such as drug combinations or places.
modes.example: either alone<< or>> in combination with other drugs and/or alcohol

modes.label: that/what starting a clause
modes.description: A relative or question word opens a clause right after a noun or verb.
modes.example: the alpacas that graze the hills of Springside Farm in the town of Pompey are sheared of fleece<< that>> is spun into baby blankets, mittens

modes.label: other connecting words
modes.description: Words like "time" or "been" fall in the middle of a phrase, just before the key content word.
modes.example: A small percentage of responders may not have<< been>> infected with M. tuberculosis

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are a mix of unrelated words such as seat, stabbed and Riding.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words like "or", "and" and "that" in the middle of a sentence.
